design_notes: Use a single accent colour (e.g., deep blue) for table headers, pull-quote rule, and sidebar border.
Financials table: right-align all numeric columns; use parentheses for negative values.
Industry snapshot: render as a three-stat strip with a proportion split bar below; no icons.
Pull-quote: set in a larger serif size, with a hairline rule above and below, centred or left-aligned.
Sidebar: box with a thin border, same accent colour, placed after the 'The IPO offer' section.
